chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

It is recommended that you perform three hundred and sixty weeks of tawaf, equal to the number of the days of the year. If you are not able, then three hundred and sixty circuits. If you are not able, then whatever amount of tawaf you are capable of.

key_terms.أَيَّامِ السَّنَةِ: the days of the year, indicating the symbolic total of three hundred and sixty
key_terms.أُسْبُوعاً: a complete set of seven circuits of tawaf
key_terms.الطَّوَافِ: the ritual circumambulation of the Ka‘bah
key_terms.تَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, circumambulation around the Ka‘bah
key_terms.شَوْطاً: a single circuit or lap of tawaf
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: it is recommended as a non-obligatory devotional act

ai.seo_question: How much tawaf is recommended for a pilgrim if they are able or unable to do more?
ai.summary: This hadith states the recommended abundance of tawaf, setting an ideal number corresponding to the days of the year. It then gives easier alternatives, showing flexibility in devotional practice according to one’s ability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2840 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):

"It is recommended to perform three hundred and sixty circuits (asbu‘an, i.e., sets of seven laps) of circumambulation, corresponding to the days of the year. If you are unable to do so, then three hundred and sixty laps (shautan, individual circuits). And if you are unable to do that, then whatever amount of circumambulation you are capable of."
